improvements: src/mcp/tools.ts:756-758 (classifyQuestion, 'results'): the wider rule now catches new decisions. Live, 'I want to test a lunch deal. We get about 140 customers a day.' and 'Ich überlege einen Mittagstisch. Wir haben ca. 140 Kunden am Tag, hier sind meine Zahlen' both come back as kind 'results' with 'It sounds like the owner is back with real numbers from a test' / 'Es klingt, als kämen echte Zahlen aus einem Test zurück'. That sends the model to whatif_log_result before any test exists. The cause: (test && counted) and ((done || back) && counted) fire when an owner simply opens with her numbers, and 'hier sind meine Zahlen' is not 'hier sind meine Ergebnisse'. Real returns still miss: 'Der Mittagstisch lief jetzt zwei Wochen, im Schnitt kamen 45 Leute mittags' and 'Nach der Preiserhöhung verkaufen wir 580 statt 620 Flat White pro Woche' read as new decisions. Fix: count a TEST word only with a past-tense DONE word ('lief', 'kamen', 'verkauften', 'after the price rise / nach der Preiserhöhung') or a RESULT word. Drop BACK + count unless a RESULT or TEST word is present. Add one line to the results text: 'If the owner has not run a test yet, call whatif_start again with template'. Why: trigger precision, and errors that tell the model what to do. Done when these four sentences and 'Wir haben 140 Gäste am Tag, hier sind meine Zahlen' sit in the table at test/mcp.test.ts:421 with the right kind.

Docs and owner texts still describe the old 401 contract. README.md:57 says 'the server answers HTTP 401' and :204 says 'Shown in the 401 message'. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:159 says 'Otherwise HTTP 401 with a JSON-RPC error'. docs/PRD.md:131, docs/PLAN.md:78 and .env.example:14 say the same. The only troubleshooting line on /connect (site/src/lib/messages-de.ts:371, connect-beta.txt:67: 'Fragt Ihre App nach einer Anmeldung? Dann fehlt in Ihrem Link der Einladungscode') names a symptom the server no longer causes. What an owner now sees is an app that shows What-IF as connected, while the AI says 'Für diese Verbindung fehlt der Einladungscode'. Rewrite these for the new contract: it connects, the tools are listed, every tool answers with the beta message, and the OAuth paths answer 404. Name the new symptom on /connect in all four languages. Also add `state` to the check_inputs and run_scenarios rows of the ARCHITECTURE tools table (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md:111-112). Why: a helper who reads the README waits for a sign-in prompt and will not recognise the real message. Done when `grep -n 401` over README.md, docs/ and .env.example finds only 'never 401' lines.

README.md:7 still says 'Live: (after deploy: …)', unchanged since loop 1. This component is the *public* MCP server, and everything verified here ran on localhost. A judge still cannot paste a URL into claude.ai. Deploy to Vercel with WHATIF_SITE_URL, WHATIF_BETA_CODES and WHATIF_BETA_CONTACT set. Put the https URL in the README, on /connect and in the skill zip. Hand judges their code with the submission. Why: a self-contained bundle that nobody can reach does not prove the stateless public endpoint. Done when `curl https://<site>/api/mcp` returns the info JSON with beta.required true, and claude.ai 'Add custom connector' with that URL and no code lists 11 tools while a tool call shows the beta message.

src/state.ts:171 (sanitise: interviews .slice(0, STATE_LIMITS.interviews)) and src/sim/rehearsal.ts:1541-1544 (recordInterview has no cap): a sixth interview is reported as '12 ausgedachte Antworten auf … gespeichert', but the token keeps only the first five. Live, after five interviews, the sixth state decoded with interviews.length 5, and its last question was 'Frage Nummer 4'. The report and every later call lose it without a word. Either refuse a sixth question in whatif_rehearsal_interview with a plain message in the owner's language (at most five questions per rehearsal: replace one or start a new rehearsal), or cap in recordInterview so encoding and decoding agree. Why: result shape and honesty; a tool must not say 'saved' about something it drops. Done when a test records six interviews and either gets the refusal or finds every saved answer in decodeState.

Smaller schema and error polish. (a) whatif_check_inputs returns no `state` until the inputs are ready (src/mcp/tools.ts:1181), yet its description says 'the `state` from the last What-IF result plus only the new `inputs`'. A model that sends only the newest answer gets the earlier answers listed as missing. Return a partial state on every check, or write 'send every answer so far until it says ready'. (b) prompts/list drops the argument descriptions of the what-if prompt ([{"name":"question","required":false},{"name":"lang","required":false}]), so slash-command UIs show no hint. Pass the descriptions so they reach the list. (c) An unknown persona id in whatif_rehearsal_interview comes back through err_internal in two languages at once: 'What-IF nie mógł tego zrobić: Unknown persona id(s): p99'. Make it a UserError in the owner's language. (d) weekday_customers 1e308 prints a 300-digit number and says '1 Zahl fehlt noch' about a value the owner gave. Clip the echo and report it only as a problem. Why: input schemas and errors. Done when each of the four has a test row.
